How to apply

Four steps, one mirror

Clusters go under your natural lashes, not on the eyelid. Work from the inner corner outward and follow your lash map.

  1. STEP 1

    Bond

    Brush Bond along the underside of your natural lashes, close to the root. Give it a moment to turn tacky.

    Uses · Bond
  2. STEP 2

    Place

    Lift a cluster from the tray with tweezers and press it under your lashes, about 1–2mm from the lash line. Repeat zone by zone.

    Uses · Tray + Tweezers
  3. STEP 3

    Seal

    Coat the lashes with Seal, then gently pinch natural lashes and clusters together so they set as one.

    Uses · Seal
  4. STEP 4

    Remove

    When you're ready, soak the band with Remover, wait a few seconds, and slide each cluster off without pulling.

    Uses · Remover
Tip

Keep oil-based cleansers and makeup removers away from the lash line while you wear clusters. Oil breaks down the bond.

Questions

Good to know

Can't find your answer? Message us from the WhatsApp button on our store at thesilkbeauty.com.

Which tray should I start with?

If it's your first time, start with the Classic Starter Kit. It has everything you need. If you already have Bond, Seal and tweezers, choose a tray that covers 8–16mm, such as B01 or B03, so you can build any map.

What length is right for me?

Most looks use shorter clusters (8–10mm) at the inner corner and longer ones (12–16mm) toward the outer corner. Try the Lash Map above to see how each look is laid out.

How long do cluster lashes stay on?

Wear time depends on your natural lashes, your routine and how well the Seal sets. With Bond and Seal applied correctly, many people wear their set for several days. Avoid oil near your lash line to keep them longer.

Can I reuse the clusters?

Often, yes. Remove them gently with the Cluster Lash Remover, clean off any leftover bond, and store them back in the tray.

How do I pay and get my order?

Checkout happens on our store at thesilkbeauty.com, with prices shown in Naira. Add your items there, pay securely, and we'll handle delivery.
